claims: Oscar Cluff currently plays for the Purdue Boilermakers during the 2025–2026 season.
Oscar Cluff previously played for Washington State.
Oscar Cluff previously played for South Dakota State.
Purdue had an NCAA Tournament run in 2026.
Purdue won the Big Ten Tournament in the 2025-26 season.
Oscar Cluff averaged 7.0 points per game for Washington State in the 2023-24 season.
Oscar Cluff averaged 4.4 rebounds per game for Washington State in the 2023-24 season.
Oscar Cluff played in 35 games for Washington State in the 2023-24 season.
Oscar Cluff hails from the Sunshine Coast, Australia.
"Cluff" is a surname of Anglo-Saxon origin.
The surname "Cluff" means "dweller in the hollow".
